name: Spooky Mission Origins
summary:
The Spooky Mission ROM-Hacking series is known for its innovative gameplay and unique game setting. Each Spooky Mission game is a testament to its ROM-Hacking era, showing off how far Zero Mission ROM-Hacking has advanced.
Spooky Mission Origins continues this trend, being created using the most advanced tooling that Zero Mission has ever had.

Spooky Mission Origins is a prequel to the Spooky Mission 1 and 2 games. The story is loosely connected to the events in Spooky Mission 1.
